ja:
STOCKS ARE MONEY WHICH A
COMPANY DIVIDES INTO SHARES
OF EQUAL AMOUNTS THAT ARE
BOUGHT AND SOLD IN THE STOCKMARKET. BUYING STOCK IN A
COMPANY MAKES YOU PART
OWNER.<WAIT>

A COMPANY ISSUES YOU STOCK
CERTIFICATES TO REPRESENT
THE NUMBER OF SHARES YOU
HAVE PURCHASED, OR IN OTHER
WORDS, HOW MUCH OF THE
COMPANY YOU OWN.<WAIT>

BY BECOMING A STOCKHOLDER,
YOU RECEIVE A PERCENTAGE OF
THE PROFITS THAT THE COMPANYMAKES.  IT ALSO MEANS THAT
YOU CAN ATTEND STOCKHOLDER
MEETINGS.<WAIT>

AT THE MEETINGS YOU'RE GIVENINFORMATION ON COMPANY
BUSINESS AND ARE ALLOWED TO
EXPRESS YOUR OPINION THROUGHYOUR PERCENTAGE OF VOTES.
<WAIT><END>
note: [스탠리 강의 4편] 7=주식이란 8=주가 9=뉴스 확보 10=매매법. 매우 긴 페이지 묶음(여러 <WAIT>). 1 LOT=1,000주

ja:
TIMING IS VERY IMPORTANT IN
THE STOCK MARKET. TO MAKE
MONEY YOU MUST BUY STOCKS
WHILE THEY ARE SELLING LOW
AND SELL STOCKS WHILE THEY
ARE SELLING HIGH.<WAIT>

STOCK PRICES DEPEND MAINLY
ON SUPPLY AND DEMAND. THE
MORE BUYERS, THE HIGHER THE
PRICES. THE MORE SELLERS,
THE LOWER THE PRICES.
<WAIT>
SEVERAL THINGS CAN AFFECT
STOCK PRICES: COMPANY SALES,COMPANY PLANS AND INTEREST
RATE FLUCTUATIONS.
<WAIT>
THE MORE SENSITIVE A COMPANYIS TO CHANGES IN INTEREST
RATES, THE MORE RISKY THE
INVESTMENT.
<WAIT>
INTEREST RATE CHANGES AFFECTHOW MUCH YOU SPEND AND BUY.
WHEN INTEREST RATES
INCREASE, YOU WILL TEND TO
SAVE MORE AND SPEND LESS.
<WAIT>
DURING A RECESSION, PRICES
ARE HIGH, THEREFORE YOU WILLTEND TO SPEND LESS.
<WAIT>
THE MORE DEBT A COMPANY HAS,THAT IS THE MORE MONEY THEY
OWE, THE MORE SENSITIVE THEYARE TO INTEREST RATES.
<WAIT>
THE HIGHER THE ASSET BASE,
THAT IS ALL PROPERTY AND
GOODS THAT HAVE HIGH VALUE,
THE LESS SENSITIVE THE
COMPANY IS TO INTEREST
RATES.<WAIT><END>
note: [스탠리 강의 4편] 7=주식이란 8=주가 9=뉴스 확보 10=매매법. 매우 긴 페이지 묶음(여러 <WAIT>). 1 LOT=1,000주

LOTS OF LUCK, YOU SHOULD BE
ABLE TO MAKE INTELLIGENT ANDPROFITABLE STOCK INVESTMENT.<WAIT>
DURING THE BUSINESS WEEK,
